question: India's rank in Tokyo Olympics 2020 is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**48**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India** achieved its highest ranking in over four decades, finishing **48th** on the medal tally in **Tokyo**.
 
• The nation competed at the 2020 Summer Olympics in Tokyo, Japan.
 
• Originally slated for **July 24 to August 9, 2020**, the games were rescheduled to July 23 to August 8, 2021, due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• India has participated in every edition of the Summer Olympics since 1920, making its official debut at the 1900 Summer Olympics in Paris.
 
• The country fielded its largest-ever contingent of 126 competitors at the 2020 Games.
 
• The 2020 Summer Olympics marked India's most successful Games since its inaugural regular Olympics appearance in 1920, with Indian athletes securing 7 medals (1 gold, 2 silver, and 4 bronze).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The 2020 Summer Olympics, **officially known as the Games of the XXXII Olympiad and branded as Tokyo 2020, were a global multi-sport event conducted from July 23 to August 8, 2021, in Tokyo, Japan, with some preliminary events commencing on July 21, 2021.
 
• Tokyo was chosen as the host city during the 125th IOC Session in Buenos Aires, Argentina, on September 7, 2013.
 
• These Games marked the fourth time that Japan hosted the Olympics, following the 1964 Summer Olympics (Tokyo), 1972 Winter Olympics (Sapporo), and 1998 Winter Olympics (Nagano).
 
• Tokyo became the first Asian city to host the Summer Olympic Games twice.
 
• The 2020 Games were part of a series of three consecutive Olympics held in East Asia, preceded by the 2018 Winter Olympics in Pyeongchang, South Korea, and followed by the 2022 Winter Olympics in Beijing, China.
